build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone with a specified depth like 18, 50, 101, or 152 for feature extraction
build_resnetv1d_backbone: build a ResNetV1d backbone with deep stem and avg down sampling for improved feature extraction
create_bottleneck_block: create a Bottleneck block with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 conv layers and optional deformable convolution support
create_basicblock: create a BasicBlock with two 3x3 conv layers and residual connection for ResNet-18 or ResNet-34
init_resnet_weights: initialize ResNet backbone weights from a pretrained checkpoint or use Kaiming initialization for conv layers
